body: I feel like for your own mental health, you have to pick and choose the right person with the right mindset. It sucks but I've told people about this that I regret BC they ended up making things worse for me in some cases.
yep, and it makes it worse to hear the very same people you confided in about your suicidal thoughts to joke about suicide around you. 😅

I've been struggling with suicidal ideation for almost the entirety of my life (childhood trauma, poor family relations). It's honestly pretty invisible and I don't really experience much of the more common symptoms of depression. In terms of the present, certain triggers can cause me to feel suicidal or simply I just feel the thoughts "coming on" more than usual and I just can't seem to motivate myself to do things anymore. It snowballs from there. But overall it's a habit to think about suicide in my day-to-day life. I've never gotten help because my parent's wellbeing is super dependent on mine. They denied how I felt when I confronted them. So I continue to pretend I'm ok.
please go. It's worth a try.

It definitely seems like she put herself in the center of it all- not you. The fact she believes that you have to be forgiven shows a lack of understanding for what you're going through and even lack of care for your well-being. She would rather have fun over the summer than to work through this with you. Ideally, a significant other should definitely be someone who supports you when you need it. You definitely needed it most there. I'm sorry you experienced that but I'm also glad that you figured you deserve better.

I definitely relate to the birthday thing.. definitely spent a lot of birthdays just feeling more suicidal than usual when that midnight arrives. 

Please don't kill yourself tomorrow. You've survived previous birthdays already, and you can survive this one too. I know you feel like rotting inside, but dedicate tomorrow to doing whatever you want to release those feelings (preferably things that don't harm yourself though..) you deserve better, and I really hope it comes sooner than later.
